title: Adverbia
subtitle: Bene, saepe, hodie — formatio ab adiectivis, et adverbia frequentia.
objectives: Formare adverbia ab adiectivis primae/secundae classis (-e)
Formare adverbia ab adiectivis tertiae classis (-iter)
Uti adverbiis temporis et frequentiae frequentibus
Distinguere adverbium ab adiectivo per officium in sententia

content.intro: Adverbium modificat verbum, adiectīvum, vel aliud adverbium — respondēns 'quōmodo?' (how). Multī adverbia dērīvantur regulāriter ab adiectīvīs.
content.explanation: Adverbium, differenter ab adiectīvō, est indēclīnābile — nūllam fōrmam mūtat secundum genus/numerus/cāsum.

rules.heading: a) Formatio: Adiectiva Primae/Secundae Classis
rules.body: Rādīx adiectīvī (invenitur removendō -us/-a/-um) + -ē: bonus → bene (well — irregulāre! nōn *bonē), longus → longē (far/at length), līber → līberē (freely). Nōtā: 'bonus' → 'bene' est excepta, sīcut 'malus' → 'male'.

examples: Hodie venio, cras discedo. — I come today, I leave tomorrow.
Saepe librōs legit. — She often reads books.

commonMistakes.wrong: Adverbium ab 'bonus' formatur *'bonē', per regulam regularem.
commonMistakes.right: 'bene' est forma irregularis (sicut 'male' ab 'malus') — memoranda separatim.
commonMistakes.why: Duo ex adverbiis frequentissimis (bene, male) sunt irregularia, non sequentia regulam standard -e.

commonMistakes.wrong: Adverbium tractatur ut declinabile, mutandum secundum genus nominis quod prope stat.
commonMistakes.right: Adverbium est SEMPER indeclinabile — una forma sola, sine respectu contextus.
commonMistakes.why: Differenter ab adiectivo, adverbium modificat verbum/actionem, non nomen — ergo non postulat concordantiam.

exercises.title: Forma Adverbium
exercises.instructions: Elige adverbium rectum derivatum ab adiectivo dato.

summary: Adverbia frequentia: hodiē, crās, heri, semper, numquam, saepe.
